create.name: Zuza Engler
create.bio:
Zuza Engler grew up in Poland and came to conscious dance almost by accident, when a friend took her to a barefoot dance evening in San Francisco in her twenties. That night began some thirty years of dancing, training and sitting practice. She teaches two free-form conscious dance practices, Soul Motion and Open Floor, and she has long practised Buddhist meditation and Gestalt, which shape how she guides people to notice what is happening inside them as they move.

She gathers her teaching under the name Moving with Life, which she describes as embodied inquiry: dance, stillness, sharing in pairs and small groups, and time outdoors, with as little instruction as possible. From her base in Sebastopol, California, she leads a Sunday morning dance practice, a yearlong training for a small group of eighteen, recorded courses and a free half-hour dance on Zoom each Wednesday. She trains and mentors other movement teachers, offers continuing-education hours to therapists, and leads week-long retreats at Esalen and in Costa Rica, often alongside her husband, Scott Engler.

courses.title: Soul Motion®: Tenderness at the Heart of the Dance
courses.description: A week-long holiday retreat at Esalen in Big Sur, co-led with Scott Engler. Days combine free-form dance to music and silence, Gestalt-based body inquiry, art-making, ritual, and sitting and walking meditation on the land. Open to anyone willing to move.

courses.title: Relax into Being: Costa Rica 2027
courses.description: A week at Blue Spirit on the Costa Rican coast, led with Scott Engler, with daily movement sessions on an unhurried schedule. The sessions range from wild dancing to very small movements and quiet listening, with plenty of free time between.

courses.title: Wake Up into Belonging: the Moving with Life Yearlong Program
courses.description: Her yearlong training for up to eighteen people: four week-long in-person modules in Sebastopol, one of them residential, plus online meetings three times a month. It covers conscious movement, embodied inner work, relating and time in nature, and suits movement teachers and coaches as well as personal practitioners. Entry is by application.

courses.title: Soul Motion®: Body Prayer
courses.description: A lightly guided Sunday morning dance practice in Sebastopol, led by Zuza or a guest teacher, exploring awareness through movement. Drop in or join by the month.
courses.price: $25 USD per class, or $75 USD per month

courses.title: Embody 101
courses.description: A self-paced online course of four modules of 45 to 60 minutes on the basics of her Moving with Life approach to movement-based inquiry. It includes the recordings of the 21 Days of Dance programme.

courses.title: 21 Days of Dance: The Movinar
courses.description: Twenty-one pre-recorded guided movement sessions, some audio and some video, each about half an hour with music. Every session opens with a short theme and ends with ideas for carrying it into daily life.

free_resources.title: Soft Release: Free Audio Class
free_resources.description: A free guided audio class of about thirty minutes with music, exploring gentle release through movement. It can be danced or simply listened to lying down as a meditation.

free_resources.title: Free Weekly Online Dance Session
free_resources.description: A free half-hour dance on Zoom every Wednesday morning, Pacific time, with Zuza or a guest guide. Expect mostly music with a little guidance, and newcomers are welcome.
